name: Boulder Lode Mine
summary: In the northeastern Barrens, the Venture Company tears into Boulder Lode Mine for its riches. Orcish banners and watchtowers mark a claim the Horde once held.

sections.title: Corporate Claim
sections.body: Weathered orcish works frame the mine mouth, signs that the Horde once held or founded the claim. Now Venture Company overseers and enforcers answer to Boss Copperplug. The goblin syndicate strips the canyon for minerals, gems, and machinery, with little care for the land or its workers.

sections.title: Gems and Schematics
sections.body: Riches from the mine have drawn attention from Ratchet. Wharfmaster Dizzywig has sent mercenaries after a rumored massive emerald found in the tunnels. Engineers seeking to understand goblin machinery also know that Boss Copperplug keeps key operating manuals in his camp.

faq.answer: The Venture Company runs Boulder Lode Mine under Boss Copperplug, with armed enforcers and overseers guarding its work.

faq.q: Did the Horde originally own this mine?
faq.answer: Weathered orcish woodwork, watchtowers, and Horde banners suggest the Horde first established or claimed the site before the Venture Company took control.

faq.q: Why is Wharfmaster Dizzywig interested in this place?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig heard that a miner unearthed an unusually large emerald in the tunnels. He hires cutthroats to steal it for a share of the profits.

faq.q: What is Boss Copperplug's connection to the samophlange?
faq.answer: Boss Copperplug holds the operating manual for the nearby samophlange machinery. Engineers in Ratchet send adventurers to recover the book and its scattered pages from his crew.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, seeing Venture Company crews work from fortifications marked with Horde standards is a bitter reminder of the cartel's reach across Kalimdor.
As a miner, you can see rich veins in the deep tunnels cut into the arid hills, where the Venture Company strips the earth without mercy.
